sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: This notice explains how Mostro.gr (“we”, “us”) handles information when you visit our website. We aim to be clear and proportionate: this is a brochure-style site about our boats and how to contact us.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
sections.body: The site is operated in connection with Mostro boat sales and marketing. For privacy questions you can contact us at Info@mostro.gr or using the details on our Contact page.

sections.heading: Information we may process
sections.body:
When you browse the site, standard technical data may be processed by our hosting provider (for example IP address in server logs for security and reliability).

If you call, email, or message us, we process the information you choose to share so we can respond to your enquiry.

The contact form on this website is for demonstration: it does not send your message to our servers automatically. When you connect a real backend, you should describe that processing here.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use a small amount of browser storage to remember your language choice and optional boat filter preferences, and to remember that you acknowledged our cookie notice. See our Cookie Policy for names and purposes.

sections.heading: Retention and security
sections.body: We keep information only as long as needed for the purpose it was collected (for example correspondence about a sale or support request). We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures appropriate to a small business website.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on applicable law (including GDPR where it applies), you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of personal data, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Contact us and we will respond in a reasonable time.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we do.

sections.heading: Agreement
sections.body: By using Mostro.gr you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.

sections.heading: Use of the website
sections.body: You may use the site for lawful, personal, or internal business purposes related to learning about our products and contacting us. Do not attempt to disrupt the site, probe for vulnerabilities, or scrape it in a way that harms performance.

sections.heading: Information about products
sections.body: Specifications, images, and descriptions are for general information. They may change without notice. A sale is governed solely by the written agreement between you and us, not by this website alone.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: Content on this site (text, images, branding) is owned by us or used with permission. You may not copy or reuse it for commercial purposes without our consent.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: The site is provided “as is” to the extent permitted by law. We are not liable for indirect loss or for issues caused by third-party services or links you follow from the site.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: Where mandatory consumer law does not say otherwise, any dispute shall be subject to the courts of Greece.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms: Info@mostro.gr or the contact details on our Contact page.

sections.heading: Do we use advertising cookies?
sections.body: No. We do not run advertising pixels or social “like” trackers on this site for marketing profiling.

sections.heading: What we store in your browser
sections.body:
We use local storage (similar in effect to cookies) for a few practical reasons:

• Language preference (key: mostro.i18n.lang) — remembers Greek or English.

• Boat filter preferences (key: mostro.gr/boat-filters) — remembers your selections on the boat listing.

• Session storage may be used briefly when navigating (for example resetting filters when you return home).

• Cookie notice (key: mostro.cookieBanner) — remembers that you dismissed the small notice bar so it does not keep reappearing.

sections.heading: Are these cookies “essential”?
sections.body: They are limited to functionality and transparency on this site. We do not use them to sell your data or to track you across other companies’ websites.

sections.heading: Managing your data
sections.body: You can clear site data from your browser settings at any time. If you clear storage, your language and filter preferences will reset.

sections.heading: Updates
sections.body: If we add analytics or marketing tools in the future, we will update this page and, where required, ask for your consent before non-essential cookies are set.
